findings.title: Explicit 'any' type usage in recurring events
findings.fix: Use a properly typed interface: const updates: Partial<GolfEvent> = {};

findings.title: Array of any types in recurring events
findings.fix: Use proper typing: let exclusions: AcademicExclusion[] = [];

findings.title: TypeScript errors suppressed with @ts-nocheck
findings.fix: Remove @ts-nocheck and fix the TypeScript errors properly with correct types

findings.title: ESLint any rule disabled globally
findings.fix: Remove the global disable and fix individual any usages with proper types

findings.title: Extensive use of 'as any' type assertions in CoachHelm V2
findings.evidence: const table = supabase.from('golf_coachhelm_settings' as any) as any;
findings.fix: Generate proper database types for new tables or create proper type interfaces instead of using 'as any'

findings.title: Golf Tables Had RLS Completely Disabled
findings.fix: RLS has since been re-enabled in migration 20260108000002_comprehensive_rls_fix.sql, but this indicates a serious security lapse where all golf data was accessible without authorization for a period of time.

findings.title: Overly Permissive Conversation Creation Policy
findings.evidence:
CREATE POLICY "Users can create conversations"
  ON conversations FOR INSERT
  TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE POLICY "Users can create participations"
  ON conversation_participants FOR INSERT
  TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (true);
findings.fix: Replace WITH CHECK (true) with proper authorization checks. Users should only be able to create conversations with participants they are authorized to message, based on the can_users_message function logic.

findings.title: Login Attempts Table Has Overly Restrictive Policy
findings.fix: The policy USING (false) blocks all access. It should specify service_role access: USING (auth.role() = 'service_role') or use proper service role grants instead of RLS.

findings.title: Function Audit Log May Allow Unauthorized Data Access
findings.fix: The table has RLS enabled but no policies defined, and only service_role has access. This is correct for audit logs, but should be documented that this table should remain service_role only.

findings.title: Incomplete RLS Policies on Intelligence Tables
findings.fix: Ensure all intelligence tables have complete RLS policies. Tables with RLS enabled but no policies will block all access.

findings.title: SECURITY DEFINER Functions Lack Sufficient Input Validation
findings.evidence:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_conversation_with_participants(
  participant_user_ids uuid[]
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
findings.fix: While the function validates that users exist, it doesn't validate that the current user can message those participants. Should call can_users_message() for each participant before adding them.

findings.title: Multiple RLS Policy Iterations Indicate Instability
findings.evidence:
Migration files show repeated RLS fixes:
- 043_fix_rls_policies.sql
- 044_restore_complete_rls_policies.sql  
- 048_rls_security_fix.sql
- 058_nuclear_rls_fix.sql
- 20260108000001_rls_audit_fixes.sql
- 20260108000002_comprehensive_rls_fix.sql
findings.fix: Implement comprehensive testing for RLS policies before deployment. Consider using a test framework that validates each policy with different user contexts.

findings.title: Pagination buttons lack aria-labels
findings.fix: Add aria-label attributes to buttons with only icon content: aria-label="Go to first page"

findings.title: Clickable div elements lack keyboard accessibility
findings.evidence:
<div className="cmdk-overlay" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
      <div className="cmdk-dialog" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
findings.fix: Use button elements instead of div elements for clickable elements, or add role="button", tabIndex={0}, and keyboard event handlers (onKeyDown)

findings.title: Modal overlay clickable div lacks keyboard accessibility
findings.evidence:
<div
      className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      onClick={onCancel}
    >
findings.fix: Add role="button", tabIndex={0}, and keyboard event handlers (onKeyDown) to make it accessible via keyboard, or use a button element as the overlay
